attempts.detail: First software-control run passed initial data/native and wrong-table rejection, then a helper sent POST to GET-only /api/state. Corrected helper; no production contract weakened. Interrupted Temp project and ui-first log retained.

First recorded-data run stalled before generation. Actual thread dumps identify reverse goals/list→workflow versus supervisor workflow→goals lock order. Removed workflow access from goals/list and added concurrent polling to integration. No passing result or skill claimed.
A second test was launched before the rebuild finished, then stopped immediately. Its partial log is retained and not counted.

The post-logging-fix run produced correct table/behavior but all three model drafts used path d on polyline elements. Actual SVGPointList length was zero and all three independent audits failed. No skill retained. Preserved full task and exact three original drafts; subsequent instructions and actual repair feedback specify points syntax and expected/observed counts. Geometry gates and draft budget unchanged.

An earlier complete live run verified content but the desktop audit logger incorrectly marked a workflow.audit step as a canvas test receipt. Preserved that development result, recorded the audit with its own artifact reference and required an actual retained audit episode step plus no timeline workflow errors on the final run.
See original complete software-control and live-model JSON. No success gate or chart tolerance lowered after failure.
